question: Who among the following was appointed Indian men's cricket team's full time T20 international captain in July 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Suryakumar Yadav**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Suryakumar Yadav** was appointed as the full-time captain of the Indian men's T20 international team in July 2024.
 
• Known for his aggressive batting style, Suryakumar has been a consistent performer in the T20 format.
 
• His appointment comes after a series of impressive performances both in domestic cricket and international T20 matches.
 
• He succeeded Hardik Pandya, who had been serving as the interim captain for the team.
 
• Suryakumar Yadav's leadership is expected to bring a fresh and dynamic approach to the Indian T20 squad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Career Overview:**

 
 
• Suryakumar Yadav, also known as SKY, made his debut for the Indian T20 team in March 2021 against England.
 
• He is known for his 360-degree playing style, often compared to AB de Villiers.
 
• Before his international debut, he was a prominent player in the Indian Premier League (IPL), representing Mumbai Indians.
 
 
 
• **Achievements:**
 
 
• He has scored multiple half-centuries and a few centuries in T20 internationals, showcasing his ability to play under pressure.
 
• In IPL, he has been one of the top run-scorers for his team, contributing significantly to their victories.
 
 
 
• **Leadership Qualities:**
 
 
• His calm demeanor on the field and ability to make strategic decisions have been appreciated by many cricket experts.
 
• He has previously captained his state team, Mumbai, in domestic cricket, gaining valuable leadership experience.
 
 
 
• **Impact on Team Dynamics:**
 
 
• As a captain, he is expected to foster a positive and aggressive mindset within the team.
 
• His rapport with young players and senior members alike will be crucial in building a cohesive unit.
